mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_insight ( member_id, insight_type, period, category_id, current_amount, previous_amount, change_rate, summary, detail_data ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{insightType}, #{period}, #{categoryId}, #{currentAmount}, #{previousAmount}, #{changeRate}, #{summary}, #{detailData} )
mapper.select: SELECT ai.insight_id, ai.member_id, ai.insight_type, ai.period, ai.category_id, c.category_name, ai.current_amount, ai.previous_amount, ai.change_rate, ai.summary, ai.detail_data, ai.created_at FROM ai_insight ai LEFT JOIN category c ON ai.category_id = c.category_id WHERE ai.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY ai.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ai.insight_id, ai.member_id, ai.insight_type, ai.period, ai.category_id, c.category_name, ai.current_amount, ai.previous_amount, ai.change_rate, ai.summary, ai.detail_data, ai.created_at FROM ai_insight ai LEFT JOIN category c ON ai.category_id = c.category_id WHERE ai.member_id = #{memberId} AND ai.insight_type = #{insightType} AND ai.period = #{period} AND ai.category_id IS NULL ORDER BY ai.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ai.insight_id, ai.member_id, ai.insight_type, ai.period, ai.category_id, c.category_name, ai.current_amount, ai.previous_amount, ai.change_rate, ai.summary, ai.detail_data, ai.created_at FROM ai_insight ai LEFT JOIN category c ON ai.category_id = c.category_id WHERE ai.member_id = #{memberId} AND ai.period = #{period} AND ai.category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY ai.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ai.insight_id, ai.member_id, ai.insight_type, ai.period, ai.category_id, c.category_name, ai.current_amount, ai.previous_amount, ai.change_rate, ai.summary, ai.detail_data, ai.created_at FROM ai_insight ai LEFT JOIN category c ON ai.category_id = c.category_id WHERE ai.member_id = #{memberId} AND ai.insight_type = 'MONTHLY' AND ai.period LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, '%') ORDER BY ai.period DESC, ai.created_at DESC

SELECT ai.insight_id, ai.member_id, ai.insight_type, ai.period, ai.category_id, c.category_name, ai.current_amount, ai.previous_amount, ai.change_rate, ai.summary, ai.detail_data, ai.created_at FROM ai_insight ai LEFT JOIN category c ON ai.category_id = c.category_id WHERE ai.member_id = #{memberId} AND ai.insight_type = 'WEEKLY' AND ai.period LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, '-W%') ORDER BY ai.period DESC, ai.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_insight SET current_amount = #{currentAmount}, previous_amount = #{previousAmount}, change_rate = #{changeRate}, summary = #{summary}, detail_data = #{detailData} WHERE insight_id = #{insightId}
